annotations.description: Common annotations for all VirtualServices resources provisioned
annotations.title: annotations

appsNamespace.description: Qvantel applications namespace name. By default value is taken from `global.appsNamespace` and equal to `qvantel`
appsNamespace.title: appsNamespace

dnsBase.description:
external-dns.alpha.kubernetes.io/target: my-global-load-balancer.cloud.com
Common base dns name to be used for all VirtualServices. `host` of VirtualServices will be set to <virtual-service-name><dnsSeparator><dnsBase>. By default values are taken from `global.ingressBaseUrl` and `global.ingressBaseUrlSeparator`
dnsBase.title: dnsBase

instances.description: List of  `VirtualService` resources to be provisioned. It is a map, so it can be configuration may be inherited/extended in multiple valyes.yaml files.
instances.title: instances

platformNamespace.description: Qvantel platform namespace name. By default value is taken from `global.appsNamespace` and equal to `platform`
platformNamespace.title: platformNamespace
